title: watch_state
description: U2 source-watcher. One row per (tenantId, sourceType, sourceId) already seen by scripts/watch/run-watch.mjs — the dedup record that makes a watch run idempotent. `_id` is the composite key `<tenantId>:<sourceType>:<sourceId>`. A Drive recording is 'new' iff no row exists here for it AND it is not already present in the ingested-session manifest (see run-watch.mjs).

sourceId.description: Drive file id, Gmail message id, or a stable calendar-row key (date+agenda slug).

sessionId.description: The data/toc-migrated session id this row's recording was ingested into, once status is 'ingested'.
